Today’s schedule is packed: golf all morning, MLB and soccer through the afternoon, then NFL at night. Watch on ESPN, Golf Channel, MLB.TV, ESPN+, CBS, Paramount+, USA Network, and NFL Network. Follow @any_and_all_sports for daily sports schedules.

Morning Golf
Tour, LPGA, DP World Tour, and Champions Tour all tee off at 12:00 AM ET. Watch on ESPN, ESPN+, CBS, and Golf Channel.

Afternoon Soccer
La Liga, Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, and more hit the afternoon window. Check ESPN Deportes, ESPN+, Paramount+, and USA Network.

MLB Spotlight
Reds-Cubs at 2:20 PM ET, then Dodgers-Tigers and Marlins-Nationals in the evening. Watch on MLB.TV and team networks.

Prime Time NFL
Commanders-Ravens at 6:00 PM ET on NFL Network. Falcons-Dolphins follow at 7:00 PM ET on CBS Miami.

Follow For Daily Schedules
Get the full day’s watch guide, updated daily. Follow @any_and_all_sports for more sports schedules.
